pages.title: About Vape Spot Australia
pages.metaDescription: Vape Spot Australia is an adult-only Australian retailer of genuine disposable vapes and vape gear. Authentic stock, 18+ ID checks, fast courier delivery to every city on the site.
pages.intro: Vape Spot Australia is a small Australian team selling genuine disposable vapes, pods and accessories to adult customers. We keep it simple: authentic stock, fair prices, fast courier delivery and a real human on Telegram when you have a question.

sections.heading: Who we are
body: Vape Spot started as a local delivery run — an adult customer ordered a vape, we dropped it off the same afternoon. Word spread, and today we courier to every city listed on the site, across Australia, usually within 30 minutes to 2 hours in metro areas.

We are a vape retailer first: every device in our catalogue is picked by hand, checked for authenticity and stored properly. We do not sell synthetic-replica or grey-market stock, and we remove any product the moment we can no longer verify its supply chain.

sections.heading: Adults only
body: Vape Spot is strictly 18+. You must be an adult to browse, order or receive a delivery. We verify age before large orders ship and our couriers require the recipient to be available and adult, with ID checked as needed.
We support sensible vaping rules in Australia. We never market to minors, and our guides page explains puff counts, nicotine strengths and how to vape responsibly.

sections.heading: Genuine products, guaranteed
body: Every device we sell is authentic. Most brands include a scratch-to-verify authenticity sticker — we show you how to check it in our guides, and if the code does not verify we replace the unit.
Because we test-stock small batches first, the catalogue you see online is real stock on hand, not drop-shipped inventory.
list: Genuine stock with verified authentication codes
Fast courier delivery to every city we list

sections.heading: Why buy from Vape Spot
body: There are a few things we hear from customers all the time: the delivery is fast, the vapes are genuine, and when something is wrong — a dead unit, a wrong flavour — we fix it without argument.
Read our delivery policy for courier times and options, our returns policy for defective units, or just message us on Telegram and ask. We answer within minutes during business hours.

pages.title: Delivery & Shipping Australia
pages.metaDescription: Vape Spot delivers by courier to every city listed on the site, across Australia — usually 30 min to 2 hrs in metro areas. Minimum order A$150. Adults 18+ only.
pages.intro: We courier to every city listed on the site, across Australia. Most metro orders arrive in 30 minutes to 2 hours; less busy areas take a little longer. Every order requires an adult to receive it.

sections.heading: Courier to every city we list
body: We deliver by courier to every city listed on the site — Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, Adelaide, the Gold Coast and all the other areas we cover. In metro areas, orders usually arrive within 30 minutes to 2 hours; sparsely populated areas can take a bit longer.
Check the discover page to see every city we cover, or message us on Telegram with your postcode and we'll confirm delivery to your exact area.

sections.heading: Australia Post for long distances
body: For very long distances beyond the cities we courier to, we ship via Australia Post with tracking on every order. Most metro orders arrive in 1–3 business days; regional and remote areas may take a little longer.
Once dispatched you'll receive your tracking number by email and on Telegram if you order with your handle.

1–3 business days metro, more for remote areas
Signature not required, but an adult must receive it

sections.heading: Minimum order & payment
body: The minimum order value is A$150. You can pay by crypto or gift card and save 15% — see the payment options at checkout.
We hold stock of every product listed, so delivery dates are accurate — not estimates from a warehouse we don't control.

sections.heading: Adult delivery & ID
body: You must be 18+ to receive a delivery. Couriers and Australia Post staff may ask for ID, and we may contact you on Telegram to confirm your age for larger orders or repeated deliveries. No exceptions.
If an order is refused at the door or undeliverable, our returns and redirection policy applies — message us on Telegram and we'll sort it out.

faq.q: Do you deliver to my city?
faq.a: We courier to every city listed on the site, across Australia. Message us on Telegram with your postcode and we'll confirm delivery to your exact area and time window.
A$150. Ordering in packs is usually the easiest way to reach it — pack pricing makes it worth it too.

faq.q: How long does courier delivery take?
faq.a: Usually 30 minutes to 2 hours in metro areas. Traffic and your exact location can push it slightly outside that window.

faq.q: Can someone else receive my order?
faq.a: Yes, as long as they are an adult (18+) and can show ID if asked.

pages.title: Returns & Refunds Policy
pages.metaDescription: Vape Spot's returns policy: defective devices replaced or refunded, wrong orders fixed fast. Vape and nicotine products are regulated — see how returns work.
pages.intro: We want every order to arrive working. If something is defective, wrong or damaged, message us on Telegram and we'll fix it quickly — replacement or refund.

sections.heading: What we cover
body: If your device is defective on arrival (doesn't fire, broken seal, empty battery that won't charge, or fails within a reasonable period), we replace it or refund it — your choice. Wrong flavour or wrong model sent? Same deal: we make it right.
Because nicotine products are regulated, we can't accept returns of opened, used or e-liquid-contaminated devices for change of mind. That keeps every unit we send out genuine and safe.
list: Defective on arrival → replacement or refund
Wrong item or flavour → corrected, no hassle
Change of mind / used products → not accepted (regulated nicotine products)

sections.heading: How to start a return
body: Message us on Telegram (@vapespot_store) or email info@vapespot.store with your order number and a short description (a photo of the device helps). We reply fast and tell you exactly what to do next.
We don't make you jump through forms or wait weeks. If it's our fault, we fix it. Simple as that.
list: A short description of the issue
A photo if possible — speeds everything up

sections.heading: Refunds
body: Approved refunds are returned to your original payment method — card, crypto or gift card — usually within a few business days. Tracked Australia Post returns for very remote areas are covered by us if the unit is found defective.
For crypto and gift card purchases, we can refund in the same form or exchange the value for store credit — your choice.

faq.q: Can I return a vape I've already used?
faq.a: No — nicotine and vape products are regulated, so we can't accept used or e-liquid-contaminated devices. But if a device is defective on arrival or within a reasonable period, we replace or refund it.

faq.q: What if I received the wrong flavour?
faq.a: Message us on Telegram with your order number and we'll send the correct one — usually same-day across metro areas.
Approved refunds return to your original payment method within a few business days.

Include your order number and a short description of your question so we can help on the first reply.

sections.heading: Age verification
body: We are an adult-only retailer. To comply with Australian vaping regulations we may ask for proof of age — a photo of ID or a quick video call on Telegram — before shipping larger orders or on repeated deliveries to the same address.
We never store your ID. Once a check is done, the file is deleted.
